skillset.skill: 13s CT - 3000% Earth DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 40.
skillset.arts: 21000% Earth DMG (PHY). For 25s, increase Human and Spirit allies' DMG by 50%. Additionally if used within the first 120s of Quest, increase allies' (except self) Arts by 50.
skillset.truearts: 75000% Earth DMG (PHY). Each time True Arts is used, permanently increase own ATK by 60% (MAX: 300%).
skillset.superarts: 200000% Earth DMG (PHY). Ignore 100% of enemies' DEF during Super Arts. Additionally if used within the first 120s of Quest, double the DMG multiplier of Super Arts.

passive.ability1: Increase own Equip DMG by 100%. Whilst the BGM is playing "Still Green", increase own Skill CT Speed by 15%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability2: At the start of a Battle, increase own Arts by 200.
passive.ability3: Increase own DMG by [1% × own ATK/100].
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Youmu Konpaku's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Youmu Konpaku's SP. Art is owned)

trueweapon.name: Roukanken
trueweapon.skill: 50s CT - 12000% Earth DMG (PHY). If user is Earth, for 10s, reduce enemies' DMG RES by 20%. Additionally if user is above 80% HP, reduce enemies' DMG RES by an additional 15%.
